{{Quote|With the training we got, I feel ready for anything.|Jax|<ref name="Death Trap" />}}
'''Jax''' was the nickname of a [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]] member and an unofficial leader of the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Jax was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]] in the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]]. After he and the other cadets were given a briefing on battle ways, he offered [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was disguising himself as a clone named "Lucky", his assistance when the other clone youths were picking on him, but Fett insisted that he could handle himself. Jax agreed, stating that they were all in it together. As time went on, Jax befriended Boba Fett, unaware that Fett was secretly attempting to kill [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for the death of his father, infamous bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He aided in the [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|evacuation]] of the ''[[Endurance/Legends|Endurance]]'' when the ship's hall was damaged by Fett. Fett secretly damaged their escape pod so they would miss the rendezvous point and their pod was intercepted by Fett's bounty hunter accomplices: [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]].<ref name="Death Trap" />

Sing revealed Boba's true identity and Jax and the clones berated Boba for betraying them. Boba apologized for it and as Sing ordered Boba to jettison the cadets into nowhere. Boba protested, saying the crew had nothing to do with his revenge against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Windu, but Sing coldly ordered him to do it. Boba reluctantly agreed and jettisoned Jax and the clones into nowhere. Just before being jettisoned, Jax shouted to Boba that he was going to regret this. Several minutes after they were jettisoned, he and [[Whiplash (Clone Youth Brigade)/Legends|Whiplash]] then had a small fight regarding Boba, when they were rescued by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who took them in his starship. Jax still believed there was some good in Boba, stating that if the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] was like them, he would realize he was wrong.<ref name="Death Trap" />

==Personality and traits==
Jax took it upon himself to become the unnamed leader of his fellow Clone Cadets in the Clone Youth Brigade. He was kind and believing, always taking up for Lucky, also known as Boba Fett, when the other Clone Cadets would harass him. Even when discovering that Boba had betrayed them, he still believed that the Mandalorian was still like them and that he would eventually see that he was wrong.<ref name="Death Trap" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jax was physically modeled on a younger [[Daniel Logan]] and voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voices all the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]].<ref name="Death Trap" />
